thesis: Machine-proposed candidate (app.evolution). Tests a 7/17-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 67-day SMA regime filter on AMD, TXN, TSM, INTC, MU, SOXX, NVDA, MSFT, ORCL, NFLX, AMZN, with a 14% stop and a 180-session time stop. Never scored before being written -- this is falsified if the crossover-inside-regime signal fails to beat this purpose's benchmark by more than the measured ordering-noise floor, across whatever windows it is actually run against.
entry: close > sma(67) and ema(7) crosses_above ema(17)
